Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
At Ascom, we’re on a mission to develop the next generation Healthcare ICT and Critical communication. We work towards Acute Care, Long Term Care and Enterprise segments building Infrastructure, Software and Solutions.
As a Senior Software Test Engineer, you are an integral part of the development and testing of our existing and newly developed software and strongly contribute to the quality of our products. You will be part of a cross functional team within a multinational environment, closely collaborating with our team in Sweden.
 Your Responsibilities Include
 Create and review requirement test documents
 Detect, track and analyze software defects and inconsistencies
 Collaborate in a cross-functional, agile team where learning and evolving together is part of our culture
 Required Qualifications
 3 - 5 years of working experience in agile development and fast-paced environment
 3 years of experience as an automation test engineer
 Experience from product and system testing in complex environments
 Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies, tools and processes
 Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test cases
 Experience in testing web applications
 Experience with Python programming language
 Fluency in English, verbal and writing
 Nice To Have Qualifications
 Experience with performance/load/stress testing tools (e.g. JMeter)
 Experience with mobile app testing tools (e.g. Selenium, Appium)
 Why Join Ascom?
 Be part of a dynamic, innovative team working on projects that truly impact safety and communication.
 Enjoy a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth and international exposure.
 Regular employment (not contractor), with a flexible office presence in Cluj (at least three days per week).
